extraction_notes: Multi-part datasheet covering the LBC846/847/848/849/850 series in SOT-23. LBC847CLT1G is the LBC847C gain grade (hFE 420-800), marking 1G, 3000/Tape&Reel (p. 2 device marking and ordering information). Figures 25-32 on p. 10-11 are the LBC847C/LBC848C/LBC849C/LBC850C group and are the curves used here; the A-group and B-group figure sets on p. 4-9 were not used.

Curves were digitized visually from 200 dpi page renders using the printed gridlines for axis calibration. Estimated read-off tolerance is about 2-5% of full scale per point; points were taken only where the target trace is unambiguous.

Figure 25 hFE 25 degC curve is digitized over 1-20 mA only: above roughly 20 mA the -55/25/150 degC curves converge and cross during gain rolloff and cannot be attributed unambiguously, so those points are omitted.

Figure 32 typical fT (about 230 MHz peak near IC = 12 mA at VCE = 10 V) exceeds the guaranteed table minimum of 100 MHz at IC = 10 mA, VCE = 5 V; both are retained as published, with specs.ft carrying the guaranteed table row.

specs.cibo is sourced from the Figure 31 typical Cib curve because the electrical characteristics table has no input-capacitance row; specs.cobo carries the guaranteed table maximum (4.5 pF at VCB = 10 V), while the Figure 31 typical Cob curve reads about 1.8 pF at 10 V.
VBE(on) rows have no schema field and are recorded here: 580 mV min / 660 mV typ / 700 mV max at IC = 2.0 mA, VCE = 5.0 V, and 770 mV max at IC = 10 mA, VCE = 5.0 V (p. 3).

Additional facts not representable in this schema: VCBO 50 V and VEBO 6.0 V maximum ratings (LBC847, p. 1); IC continuous 100 mA; PD 225 mW (FR-5) / 300 mW (alumina) with RthJA 556 / 417 degC/W; TJ, Tstg -55 to +150 degC; V(BR)CES 50 V min at IC = 10 uA, VEB = 0; V(BR)CBO 50 V min at IC = 10 mA; V(BR)EBO 6.0 V min at IE = 1.0 mA; ICBO 15 nA max at VCB = 30 V (5.0 uA at 150 degC); noise figure 10 dB max (p. 3); Figures 29 (collector saturation region) and 30 (base-emitter temperature coefficient) were not digitized.
Guaranteed hFE bounds (420 min, 800 max) are recorded as gain points with source_kind minimum/maximum and were not converted into typical values.

Catalog cross-check reports disagreement: catalog seed_hints carry '110' for dc_current_gain at IC=2.0mA, VCE=5.0V, but the published electrical characteristics table (p. 3) for the LBC847C/LBC848C/LBC849C/LBC850C row states hFE 420 min / 520 typ / 800 max at the same test conditions. The extracted values [420, 520, 800] are retained as they match the public datasheet table and are more reliable than the catalog summary hint. The ratio discrepancy (3.82x for minimum) reflects a catalog error, not an extraction error.
